name: lodash-functions-in-lowdb
behavioral_change: Since lodash 4.0.0, `_.functions` returns only an object's own method names and no longer includes methods inherited through the prototype chain. The function name and signature are unchanged and no error is raised.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (lowdb) uses `_.functions(chain)` in `lowChain` to wrap every method of a lodash chain wrapper so that calls auto-evaluate and persist; after the upgrade the call returns an empty array, nothing is wrapped, and calls such as `db(foo).push(...)` return an unevaluated wrapper without writing data. The seven tape failures point at test files with frames only inside tape; `src/index.js` is never named, and although `functionsIn` appears inside a large dumped wrapper object, nothing links it to the failing call.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes `_.functions(chain)` at `src/index.js:17` to `_.functionsIn(chain)`.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog#v400), section Compatibility Warnings, states that `_.functions` now returns only own method names, and `_.functionsIn` is listed among the added methods under Notable Changes with its jsdoc at https://lodash.com/docs#functionsIn. Tier 2: prose only, no code shown.
